text.en:
There are hereby ceded, transferred and conveyed in absolute ownership for the nominal sum of
one peso (P1.00) to Barangay Claro M. Recto, Angeles City, a political subdivision, created under Republic
Act No. 3590, as amended, otherwise known as the "Revised Barrio Charter", Lots Nos. 1, 2 and 3,
Swo-03-000002, situated in said City: Provided, That said Barangay may, with the approval of the Secretary
of Natural Resources, exchange the lots herein conveyed with another parcel within its territorial jurisdiction
which is suitable for the construction of its barangay hall and other allied improvements and/or sell one of the
lots to generate funds to underwrite such construction; and Provided, further That no portion within the
30-meter right of way of the MacArthur Highway shall be disposed of.

The Register of Deeds concerned shall register the deed of conveyance and issue the
corresponding certificate of title to Barangay Claro M. Recto.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 21st day of April, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-seven.
